subject: Biology
standard_explanation: The cell is the basic structural, functional, and biological unit of all known living organisms. Often referred to as the building blocks of life, cells can be prokaryotic (lacking a membrane-bound nucleus, e.g. bacteria) or eukaryotic (possessing a true membrane-bound nucleus and specialized organelles, e.g. plants and animals). Essential organelles include the cell membrane, which regulates the entry and exit of substances; the nucleus, containing genetic instructions in DNA; mitochondria, generating biochemical energy (ATP); and in plant cells, chloroplasts, responsible for photosynthesis.
simplified_explanation: Every living creature is built of tiny living rooms called cells! Your body has trillions of them. Each cell has a wall called a membrane that keeps it safe, a brain inside called the nucleus that gives instructions, and tiny powerhouses called mitochondria that make energy so you can run and play!
key_points: Cells are the fundamental building blocks of all living things.
The cell membrane is a protective barrier that controls what goes in and out.
The nucleus is the control center holding the cell's DNA instructions.
Mitochondria are the powerhouses that generate cellular energy (ATP).
Plant cells also have chloroplasts to capture sunlight and rigid cell walls.
examples: Skin cells form a protective waterproof sheet covering your whole body.
Muscle cells are packed with mitochondria to provide bursts of energy for running.
misconceptions: Misconception: All cells are identical. Fact: Cells specialize into hundreds of distinct shapes and functions like neurons, muscle fibers, and blood cells.
Misconception: Cells are flat like textbook drawings. Fact: Real cells are 3D jelly-like compartments filled with fluid organelles.

visual_scenes.title: Meeting the Living Cell
visual_scenes.description: A translucent 3D cellular sphere surrounded by a flexible outer membrane floating in nutrient fluid.
visual_scenes.caption: Meet the cell! The cell membrane keeps the inside safe and organized.

visual_scenes.title: The Nucleus Control Center
visual_scenes.description: Zooming into the center: a golden sphere holding coiled DNA ladders glowing with biological instructions.
visual_scenes.caption: The nucleus in the center holds DNA instructions for the whole cell.

visual_scenes.title: Mitochondria Powerhouses at Work
visual_scenes.description: Oval mitochondria pulsing with energy sparks, churning out ATP batteries to power cell activities.
visual_scenes.caption: Mitochondria powerhouses turn food into energy so the cell can work!

visual_scenes.title: Harmonious Living Factory
visual_scenes.description: All cell organelles working together: membrane, nucleus, mitochondria, and transport tubes in full motion.
visual_scenes.caption: All parts cooperate as a tiny living factory building your body!
